title: Lighter steering feel and socket changes
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes comments about lighter steering and vehicle feel with complaints about missing or changed power and USB sockets, while many snippets are too brief to determine clear sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on lighter steering reducing perceived stability and on the absence of a 12V socket.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback says the car feels lighter but also less solid and noisier than an older 3 Series.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mention lighter steering, lighter doors or design, a 12V supply reference, and a preference for a normal USB socket, but the short excerpts do not make sentiment consistently clear.

limitations: This cluster mixes several subjects, including steering feel, overall lightness or solidity, door or design impressions, and power or USB socket details.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined and very short, so the available examples are insufficient to draw a clearer sentiment pattern for several aspects.
The samples are stratified and not representative estimates of overall owner experience.
